title: Eval-2 headed multi-model results
description: Task × model cells for headed eval-2 experiments. Metrics are product_bar (HAPPY / NOT_HAPPY) and oracle (PASS / FAIL). Optional per-result cost/token/wall fields rank HAPPY cells on cost for results — omit them when unknown; never invent scores or run costs. This is not the 17-task string-harness hard_pass_rate / C²/$ schema.

updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the last honest edit to this file.

gate_model.description: OpenRouter id of the headed / GDPval gate model. Keith: Gemini 3.8 Flash until HAPPY; gpt-oss is not the product gate.

source_of_truth.description: Repo-relative path of the living headed autopsy (or later notes) used to seed cells.

id.description: scripts/eval_2_headed.py --task id (not the parked letterhead stub).

product_bar.description: Headed product/task success. HAPPY means the deliverable did the job even if a soft oracle is red.

oracle.description: CLI oracle PASS/FAIL for the saved deliverable. Fail-closed. Soft notes go in oracle_note.

stamp.description: Headed runs/<stamp>/ directory name as cited in-repo (may be abbreviated with … in autopsy).

source.description: Repo-relative doc citation for this cell.

run_artifacts_committed.description: True only when the stamp dir is in git. Autopsy paths are often box-local / untracked.

patches.description: Private / unmerged product patches on that stamp, if any.

total_tokens.description: Prompt + completion tokens for this headed stamp. Omit when unknown — do not invent.

input_tokens.description: Prompt / input tokens for this headed stamp. Omit when unknown.

output_tokens.description: Completion / output tokens for this headed stamp. Omit when unknown.

total_cost_usd.description: USD cost of this headed stamp (live OpenRouter pricing when known). Omit when unknown — do not invent.

wall_time_s.description: Wall time of the headed run in seconds. Omit when unknown.

intelligence_per_dollar.description: HAPPY successes per USD: 1 / total_cost_usd when product_bar is HAPPY and total_cost_usd > 0. Omit otherwise. Distinct from string-harness C²/$ (correctness² / avg $/task).
